summary: Tested two new features for SR Rénovation: (1) Selection of company profile per quote (profile_id snapshot in Quote.company), (2) Unlimited dynamic additional_options with proper line-level € (amount) remise and option-level € remise. Backend 8/8 pytest tests PASSED. Frontend UI verified: profile-select-desktop changes live preview company card (SR Rénovation vs Câble Ethernet Ugreen), add-option-btn creates dynamic-option-{0..N} with renumbered labels (Option 2, 3, 4...), remove-option-0-btn only removes that one option keeping others, save-quote-btn-desktop present.

issues: React hydration warnings in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <th>/<tr>/<tbody>' — caused by Emergent visual-editor wrapper spans (data-ve-dynamic) injected around <th>/<tr>/<tbody>. Visible only as console warnings, does not affect functionality, but pollutes the console and may cause hydration mismatches in production builds.

frontend_ui_tests.profile_switch_updates_live_preview_comp: PASS - 'SR Rénovation' appears in PDF preview after switching from default 'Câble Ethernet Ugreen'
frontend_ui_tests.remove_option_0_only_removes_that_option: PASS - after remove, remaining [0,1] kept and renumbered
frontend_ui_tests.edit_quote_reloads_dynamic_options: Verified via backend GET — additional_options persist with totals

features_verified: ✓ POST /api/quotes accepts profile_id and snapshots company into Quote.company (company_name = profile.company_name)
✓ PUT /api/quotes/{id} switches snapshot when profile_id changes
✓ Default profile fallback works when no profile_id provided (uses is_default=True profile, currently Câble Ethernet Ugreen)
✓ Service-level remise_type='amount' with remise_montant correctly reduces line total (200 - 30 = 170)
✓ additional_options array of OptionBlock supports unlimited options (tested 3 options simultaneously)
✓ compute_option_block correctly computes total_brut, remise (amount or percent), total_net, acompte_30
✓ Legacy option_2_* / option_3_* fields derived from first two dynamic options for retro-compat
✓ Frontend profile-select-desktop binds to selectedProfileId and updates previewDoc.company immediately
✓ Frontend add-option-btn appends to additionalOptions array creating dynamic-option-{idx} with renumbered labels Option N+1
✓ Frontend remove-option-{idx}-btn calls removeOption(idx) deleting only that option, others stay (verified visually: Option 2 + Option 3 kept after deletion of one)
✓ Live PDF preview re-renders company card and additional_options on every state change
action_items: Optional: clean console hydration warnings by removing data-ve-dynamic spans from <thead><tr><th> / <tbody> structure in PDFPreview.js ServicesTable (lines ~107-118). These appear to be injected by Emergent visual editor tooling.

Optional UX: when user clicks 'Enregistrer' with an empty dynamic option (no services), the existing toast warning is good; consider also auto-removing trailing empty options OR adding visible inline error on the empty option block.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:537-558 — _legacy_block helper duplicated between create_quote and update_quote (DRY violation, ~20 lines). Extract to a single module-level helper.

server.py:528 — `remise = remise_from_pct if input.remise_percent > 0 else round(input.remise_montant, 2)` — Option 1 still uses percent-OR-amount conditional. Aligns with frontend totals1 logic, but Service model has remise_type='percent'|'amount' which is clean; consider applying same pattern to Option 1 global remise (introduce remise_type at quote root level for consistency).
QuoteForm.js (1240 lines) — exceeds 700-line guideline, should be split into smaller components (ServiceRow, DynamicOptionsList, ProfileSelector, PaymentPlanSelector).
PDFPreview.js — console hydration warning due to visual-editor span wrappers around table elements. Not a logic bug but creates noise; consider guarding behind a build-time flag.
Both POST and PUT routes correctly call resolve_company(profile_id) and synchronize legacy option_2/option_3 fields. Looks solid.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on verified flows (profile switch, dyn options add/remove, key selectors present)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests created ~7 quotes with work_location starting 'TEST QA - a supprimer'. Module-level autouse fixture deletes them via DELETE /api/quotes/{id} after tests finish. No emails sent (no /api/quotes/{id}/send calls).
